question_text: Explain how the call stack supports a recursive function that reduces n by 1 until a base case.
adaptation_rationale: Recursion memory use and stack operations explicitly scoped. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Each call pushes a frame with local state/return location. Frames accumulate asn decreases. Atbase case returns start; most recent frame resumes first and pops, restoring previous call state until original call returns.
